identity_check: Confirmed as SalesPatriot (salespatriot.com), the San Francisco / Warsaw start-up (YC W25) founded in 2024 by Nelson Ray, Benjamin Rhodes-Kropf and Maciej Szymczyk that builds an AI operating system for defence, aerospace and industrial parts distributors, OEMs and procurement teams. The name is unique in search; Pear VC's portfolio page ('AI operating system for defense and aerospace procurement') and the YC company page both link to salespatriot.com, and press on the Oct 2025 seed names the same founders. Category set to 'adjacent' (PROJECT_CONTEXT seed): it automates RFQ/bid quoting, sourcing and order management, which overlaps our procurement and RFQ agents, but its buyers are defence and aerospace parts distributors, OEM sales/procurement desks and MRO sustainment teams working government portals and ERPs, not plant-floor staff of manufacturers, and it does not touch maintenance or process stability.

open_items: Pre-seed amount not found: press says the $5M seed brings total funding to $6.3M, implying about $1.3M raised earlier (likely including the YC W25 investment), but no page describes that round's amount, date or investors.

Euro figure: some outlets reportedly gave the seed as about EUR 4.2M (a bebeez.eu URL slug says 'e4-2-million'), but that page returned 404 and tech.eu's fetched article gives only USD 5M; USD figure recorded.
The company's own seed post (salespatriot.com/blog/5-million-seed-funding, linked from its YC page) returned 404.
Partnerships announced on the company blog, not recorded as customers: S&K Aerospace (Oct 2026, agentic AI across S&K's MRO enterprise) and Maven Engineering Corporation (Jun 2026).
Revenue not publicly reported; press cites customers' teams managing over $200 million in annual Pentagon orders, which is order volume handled, not company revenue.

company.name: SalesPatriot
company.description: San Francisco / Warsaw start-up selling AI that automates quoting, sourcing and order management for defence and aerospace parts distributors and OEMs.

layer_detail: Supply-chain back office rather than the plant floor: an AI operating system (products Forge for operations, Vantage for visibility, Bedrock for integrations) that pulls data from government procurement portals, ERPs, spreadsheets and email to automate bid/quote preparation, sourcing and order management for defence and aerospace parts distributors, OEMs and MRO sustainment teams. 'Plant_ops' is the nearest layer; there is no supply-chain layer in the taxonomy.
product_summary: AI platform for defence, aerospace and industrial parts distributors and OEMs that ingests government portal, ERP, spreadsheet and email data, then automates bid and quote preparation, sourcing and order management; the company says suppliers process orders up to seven times faster and one customer raised bid volume 283%.
